{"rule": "Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and a new passage of about 250 words in the text field.", "text": "The Friday he did not open at nine. He sat upstairs with the coffee going cold and watched the light move across the floorboards until it reached the chair leg, which he had decided, sometime in the night, would be the signal. When it reached the chair leg he went down.

The Portuguese verse was still on the shelf by the window. He had half expected it to have moved, the way things in the shop sometimes seemed to, though he knew it was only that he forgot where he put them. He did not touch it. He turned the sign and stood behind the counter with his hands flat on the wood.

The council man came at eleven. He was younger than his voice had been and he had a clipboard and a photograph of the tar already, taken from the bus depot side, and he wanted to know whether the shop had suffered any damage, which it had not, and whether the strip had been there long, which it had. He wrote things down. He said someone would come with a van. He said it the way people say things they have said before and expect to say again.

When he had gone the shop was very quiet. The three envelopes he had already read were back under the paperweight. The fourth was in his pocket, folded once, the two lines facing in.

He thought about writing back. He got as far as a pen. Then a woman came in wanting something about gardens, and he was glad, and he sold her the wrong one, and let her go."}
